{{Short description|Bangladeshi academic}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=February 2026}}
'''Rostom Ali''' is a Bangladeshi academic and former vice-chancellor of [[Pabna University of Science and Technology|Pabna University of Science & Technology]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-01-01 |title=Sanjeev Kumar Bhatti, Assistant High Commissioner of Indian High Commission Office in Rajshahi is handing over a dummy key of an ambulance to Professor Dr M Rostom Ali, Vice-Chancellor of Pabna University of Science and Technology (PUST) in a ceremony held on the university campus on Thursday. — Sun Photo |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/printversion/details/599456 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=Daily Sun |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Pabna court summons outgoing PUST VC in defamation case |url=https://www.newagebd.net/print/article/166288 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=New Age}}</ref> He is a former professor of the Department of applied chemistry and engineering at the [[University of Rajshahi]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=7 March 2018 |title=Prof. M Rostom Ali new VC of PUST |url=https://www.jagonews24.com/en/education/news/37939 |access-date=8 February 2024 |work=[[Jagonews24.com]]}}</ref>

==Early life==
Ali was born on 16 March 1960 in [[Pabna District]], [[East Pakistan]], [[Pakistan]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |date=2018-03-07 |script-title=bn:পাবিপ্রবিতে নতুন উপাচার্য : সকালে নিয়োগ, দুপুরে কাজে |url=https://ntvbd.com/education/184753/%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%AA%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A4%E0%A7%87-%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%A4%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%A8-%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%9A%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AF--%E0%A6%B8%E0%A6%95%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B2%E0%A7%87-%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BF%E0%A7%9F%E0%A7%8B%E0%A6%97-%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%AA%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%87-%E0%A6%95%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%9C%E0%A7%87 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=NTV |language=bn}}</ref> He studied at Natia Bari Govt. Primary School.<ref name=":1" /> He graduated from [[Rajshahi Collegiate School]] and [[Ishwardi Government College]] in 1973 and 1976 respectively.<ref name=":1" /> He completed his bachelor's degree and masters in chemistry at the University of Rajshahi in 1982 and 1983 respectively.<ref name=":1" /> He did his PhD at the Tokyo Institute of Technology.<ref name=":1" />

==Career==
Ali joined the [[Bangladesh Institute of Technology, Chittagong]] as a lecturer of chemistry.<ref name=":1" /> He joined the University of Rajshahi in 1989.<ref name=":1" /> He was promoted to assistant professor in 1992.<ref name=":1" />

In April 2010, Ali was elected to the Rajshahi University Teachers' Association from the pro-Awami League yellow panel.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2010-04-13 |title=Pro-AL panels win RU elections |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-134209 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref>

In March 2018, Ali was appointed the vice-chancellor of Pabna University of Science & Technology replacing Professor Dr. Al-Nakib Chowdhury.<ref name=":0" />

In October 2019, students at Pabna University of Science & Technology demanded Ali resign following allegations of taking bribes from candidates for faculty positions at the university.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-10-28 |title=PUST students demand VC's resignation |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/pust-students-demand-vcs-resignation |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Business Standard |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-10-26 |title='You took Tk8 lakh but did not give me the job' |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/you-took-tk8-lakh-did-not-give-me-job |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Business Standard |language=en}}</ref> Students of the university wanted the vice-chancellor removed from the university.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Protesters at Pabna university want VC to go [ Tritiyo Matra News ] |url=https://tritiyomatra.com/news/25827/local/2019/11/protesters-at-pabna-university-want-vc-to-go |access-date=2024-02-09 |website=tritiyomatra.com |language=en}}</ref>

In January 2022, chairman of the mathematics department, Harunur Rashid, was assaulted when he tried to enter a recruitment meeting of his department.<ref name=":2">{{Cite news |date=2022-01-28 |title=PUST dept chair 'assaulted', barred from hiring board |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/youth/education/campus/news/pust-dept-chair-assaulted-barred-hiring-board-2948891 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> Rashid blamed Ali for the incident.<ref name=":2" /> In February 2022, he was confined in his office by students for four hours over allegations of irregularities in recruitment of 101 people.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-02-10 |title=PUST VC freed after 4 hours of confinement |url=https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/pust-vc-freed-after-4-hours-of-confinement |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=Prothom Alo |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite news |title=PUST VC freed after 4 hours of confinement |url=https://www.observerbd.com/news.php?id=352665 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Daily Observer}}</ref> He was freed by [[Bangladesh Police]].<ref name=":3" /> He was accused of mismanagement in the recruitment by faculty staff of the university.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-01-27 |title=PUST teacher accuses VC of manipulating recruitment process |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/youth/education/campus/news/pust-teacher-accuses-vc-manipulating-recruitment-process-2948591 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> In March 2022, he was summoned to a Pabna District Court in a defamation case filed by Awal Kabir Joy, proctor of Pabna University of Science & Technology.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Pabna court summons outgoing PUST VC in defamation case |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/166288/pabna-court-summons-outgoing-pust-vc-in-defamation-case |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=New Age |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-03-24 |title=PUST teacher files defamation case against former VC |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/youth/education/campus/news/pust-teacher-files-defamation-case-against-former-vc-2989756 |access-date=2024-02-09 |work=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Ali is married Sharmeen Ali.<ref name=":1" />
